cards.review_notes: The homepage confirms summer camps but does not specify their format or explicitly identify the camp drop-off site. Day format and use of the published stables address should be confirmed with the provider. The homepage says Tommy Campbell Road is closed on the Cherokee Road side; access is from Highway 81.
